title: Spielberg's live IMAX interview for Disclosure Day

tellings.quote: Yes. Might be. He said last night at our at the thing that you and I were watching in the live interview at at the IMAX,

plain: In 2026, the film director Steven Spielberg spoke in a live interview at an IMAX theater tied to Disclosure Day, his UFO film, and said something there that Bryce Zabel brings up. Zabel, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the Central Intelligence Agency and UFOs, says he and Michels watched the interview together "last night." The telling does not say in these words what Spielberg said.
